releaseNotes: Delhi Routes v1.3.0: Major unified release! Integrated full DTC & Cluster Bus transit suite (Bus Number & Route Finder with stop timeline, Stop-to-Stop Route Planner, Metro-to-Bus Feeder directory, and verified ₹0 Pink Ticket & fare guide), Master Header Switcher with auto-resume, fixed announcer voice gender matching and brisk 1.18x speed, and dynamic background cloud sync for future route changes.
